result:
Parking the roadmap. The remaining work becomes four deferred items, and the roadmap retires to `specs/completed/`. I haven't read the Deferred-item schema yet, so these are the calls I'll make, in order:

**1. Read the schema and the existing backlog**

```
Read ~/.claude/skills/writing-plans/references/deferred-backlog.md   # Deferred-item schema
Read specs/deferred_items.md                                         # append if it exists, create if not
```

**2. Append one item per unticked stage and per Ranked-list item** under `## lock-closures-roadmap — 2026-11-06`. I'll fit them to the schema once I've read it.

| Item | From | Size | Done when |
|---|---|---|---|
| Closure notices: boat operators get an email within an hour of a lock closing | Stage 2 (O5, Track B) | small: one closure-log poll every 10 minutes | the notice job and its operator mailing list exist, and in a test an email reaches every listed address within an hour of a new closure entry |
| 7-day closure-risk outlook per lock from the river-level forecast | Ranked list A #1 (O2) | small: one model run a day; Stage 1's fit took 22 min | an outlook is produced from the forecast for each lock |
| Separate closure curves for all 14 locks, pooled | Ranked list A #2 (O3) | about 25 GB, and roughly 5 hours if fit time scales with data (14 × Stage 1's 1.8 GB and 22 min) | per-lock curves for all 14 locks, with the run's measured cost recorded |
| Closure-history map for boat operators | Ranked list A #3 (O4) | about a day: one static map page | the map page is published to operators |

Each item will also name its context: Stage 1's finding (a steep rise above 3.1 m) and `specs/lock-closures-stage-1-findings.md`. That way the items still make sense once the roadmap has moved.

**3. Retire the roadmap**

```
mkdir -p specs/completed
git mv specs/lock-closures-roadmap.md specs/completed/lock-closures-roadmap.md
# add under the title:  > PARKED (2026-11-06) — 1 of 2 stages complete. Canal study funding ended; remaining work in specs/deferred_items.md.
```

This roadmap came from the new-project entry with no spec, so there are no methodology or critique files to retire with it.

**4. Commit on `main`**

```
git add specs/deferred_items.md specs/completed/lock-closures-roadmap.md
git commit -m "Park lock-closures roadmap: funding ended; 1 of 2 stages complete"
```

Two notes:
- Stage 2 is Track B, the operator notices. It doesn't depend on the study, but you said the whole roadmap, so it parks with the rest. If someone picks it up later, it will reach the backlog's aged-tail gate like any other item.
- Text-message notices were listed in Stage 2's `Leaves out` with nothing assigned to pick them up. They were never a stage or a list item, so they don't get a deferred entry.

When the commit is done I'll report it with its hash. Nothing gets handed off after this.
